The abstract enumerates the eight synthesis steps by product name only (1)2-chloro-6-methanesulfonyltoluene ... 8)tembotrione) with no reagents, conditions, quantities or unit operations, so it holds no procedure for A2 to read and contains_procedure is false on that basis. Claim 1 at lines 43-76 recites the full eight-step process with real unit operations (charge, dropwise addition, reflux, extraction, concentration) but no quantities; dependent claims 2-8 at lines 77-95 add molar ratios and solvent lists. The p03 page comment at line 80 falls inside claim 2, which is split across pages: line 77 ends mid-word at 二氯甲 and line 82 resumes with 烷, so the page boundary is demonstrably not a section boundary. estimated_steps = 8 follows the patent's own numbering. Caveat for A2 scoring: recited step 6) contains two transformations (trifluoroethoxide displacement, then NaOH hydrolysis of the ester) and step 7) contains two (SOCl2 acid chloride formation, then esterification with cyclohexanedione), so a transformation-level decomposition would give 10, not 8.

[0002] describes tembotrione and its activity; [0003] lists three drawbacks of the prior art route (sodium methanethiolate odour and untreatable mercaptan waste water, high production cost, expensive NBS as brominating agent).
